label: standalone/async-closed-image-metadata-channel

author_runs.reason: Windows shutdown alone did not finish pending WSARecv; owners remained unproven. Test teardown cancelled residual test tasks and logged WinError6. Failed test process subsequently exited.

tested: Exclusive owned connected noninheritable stream socket; one ordered worker CREATE/guardian-built ACK exchange with nonce/PID/birth binding and replay refusal.
Four-byte length, <=8192 canonical ASCII JSON; size before allocation, flat depth before parse, strict builtin types, duplicate/float/constant/large-number/schema rejection.
Actual fragmented/partial frames, EOF, blocked send/receive, repeated cancellation and deadline on private socketpairs.
Poison, shutdown, known socket-close success, then retained UNCANCELLED logical IO completion before closed=true. Buffers/tasks stay owned throughout.

Live pre-close fault permits retry; a fault after real close models lost authority and remains permanently unproven. It is not a real induced OS close failure; the test socket is closed and no IO remains, while proof-owner stays retained until process drain.
limits: No generic payload API or argv/env/auth/prompt data. Metadata grammar grants no model/production authority.
No share/fromshare/bootstrap transfer or retained source-process authentication; future transfer must use actual original held live target incarnation.
No guardian object/image checks, durable host ACK, whole-job/worker-death recovery or full three-actor SDK transport qualification.
Lost close authority/permanently uncooperative IO stays unproven until enclosing process drain; green tests do not claim all negative fixtures produced successful cleanup.
Capture/bootstrap/profile consumers unchanged; no historical capture11/bootstrap13/native20/V6/where rerun.
Windows socketpair proof only; final-head Linux CI, all18 eligibility, business and rollout gates remain open.
